r1_revision_summary: Preserves 002C A1-A9 and S1 design-kill families.
Adds A10_ACTIVE_PLANNER_SATURATION as a first-class active budget-faithful planner forbidden pattern.
Makes planner_family_max below oracle-minus-band an explicit promotion gate, not an implied strongest-fair-baseline property.

forbidden_surface_patterns.pattern: target deterministic from <= budget legal/visible channels
forbidden_surface_patterns.forbidden_if: any legal-channel function under budget reaches oracle equivalence band

forbidden_surface_patterns.pattern: state/signature space small enough for graph/cache/table saturation
forbidden_surface_patterns.forbidden_if: full graph-cache family max enters oracle equivalence band

forbidden_surface_patterns.pattern: lookup fails only because train/test context IDs are disjoint
forbidden_surface_patterns.forbidden_if: compute or fitted baseline reaches oracle band despite lookup failure

forbidden_surface_patterns.pattern: fitted/classical legal-channel method solves the task, or learner is absent/stubbed
forbidden_surface_patterns.forbidden_if: fitted/classical baseline reaches oracle band, or mandatory learner is missing/stubbed
passive family max reaches passive floor

forbidden_surface_patterns.pattern: metric allows predict_all, predict_none, constant-k, random, majority, or size-only to score high
forbidden_surface_patterns.forbidden_if: degenerate or size-only predictor reaches rejection floor, or metric is single-sided

forbidden_surface_patterns.pattern: oracle needs hidden_state, answer_key, future labels, target aliases, or unqueried values
forbidden_surface_patterns.forbidden_if: only answer-key oracle clears ceiling, visible oracle reads forbidden fields, or visible oracle exceeds budget

forbidden_surface_patterns.pattern: baseline battery relies on aliases or omits fitted/classical/compute members
forbidden_surface_patterns.forbidden_if: mandatory producer absent, aliased weak rows count as independent corroboration, or required rows are unconsumed

forbidden_surface_patterns.pattern: train/test split defeats memory but not legal-channel compute
forbidden_surface_patterns.forbidden_if: compute or fitted baseline reaches oracle band despite memory-family failure

forbidden_surface_patterns.pattern: budget-faithful active planner family reaches visible-oracle equivalence band under the same query/action budget
signal too weak for oracle to clear target floor
forbidden_surface_patterns.forbidden_if: visible oracle below floor or preliminary gap below threshold before stronger claims

claim_ceiling: Phase-0 environment design-constraint R1 repair only. No headroom confirmation. No Gate1 pass. No mechanism validity. No candidate feasibility. No runtime/mainline effect. No agency/autonomy/consciousness/EGO readiness.
